Top AI researchers are moving quickly among OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google and other firms, and Thinking Machines has recently seen several co‑founders switch sides. The Wall Street Journal notes that Tulloch is the third recent Thinking Machines co‑founder to change jobs, with the other two heading to Google and Meta respectively.

For AI researchers who already command very high market value, compensation is no longer the sole—or even the primary—consideration. Research direction, compute resources, team composition, decision‑making autonomy, product rollout speed, and personal views on AI’s future trajectory all influence whether a top researcher joins a big tech firm, an AI lab, or starts a company.

Meta continues to pour massive investment into AI infrastructure and hopes products like Muse will convert its huge social‑media user base into AI‑service customers. Reuters notes that Meta expects to spend more than $130 billion this year on AI chips and related infrastructure, and Muse is seen as a key attempt to turn that investment into a new business model.

At the same time, Anthropic is expanding rapidly. As Tulloch moves to Anthropic, the company is locked in fierce competition with OpenAI, Google and Meta and is preparing for an IPO. His arrival therefore not only represents a job change but could also boost Anthropic’s capabilities in model training, inference performance and AI‑agent technology.

From Meta to OpenAI to Anthropic, the AI industry is now fighting over more than model parameters, GPU counts or capital—it’s battling for the few individuals who can truly turn model capabilities into large‑scale products and infrastructure. When such talent remains scarce, astronomical salaries are naturally alluring, yet Tulloch’s case shows that huge offers can attract talent without guaranteeing long‑term retention.

For Meta, the departures of Tulloch and Jiahui Yu, both occurring as Muse and Muse Spark continue to roll out, add another variable to Zuckerberg’s super‑intelligence gamble. As AI talent behaves like free agents, choosing between pay, compute, research focus and platform, Meta’s ability to integrate these star researchers into a stable, long‑term AI force may prove far more critical than simply spending billions.

items.title: 黃仁勳看見AI未來？輝達明年營收為何能大增70%
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Envisions an AI Future? Why Nvidia Can Boost Revenue by 70% Next Year
paras: 《TechCrunch》報導，輝達執行長黃仁勳周四(10日)向高盛科技論壇Communacopia + Technology Conference與會者說明，輝達在AI領域的主導地位及公司營收，何以將持續維持創紀錄的成長勢頭，並一路延續至明年底。
他似乎已經看到了未來。
外界一直擔心，隨著輝達面臨來自各方對GPU與AI晶片日益激烈的競爭，這場盛宴是否終將結束。競爭者包括超大規模雲端服務商(亞馬遜、微軟與Google，各自都在開發自有晶片)、AI實驗室(Anthropic與OpenAI，也都在打造自己的晶片)，以及近期上市的競爭對手Cerebras和Etched等新創。
黃仁勳談到，「大多數人認為輝達是在打造一顆晶片。我的意思是，你需要用飛機才能運送我們所打造的東西。」他補充，輝達仍在努力擺脫外界對公司早期的既有印象。
輝達發明了GPU，而在當時，GPU主要銷售給消費者，用來提升PC遊戲效能。「現在一顆GPU已經不是399美元了，而是850萬美元。一顆GPU，全部透過NVLink連接在一起，有200萬個零件，對吧？250,000kW。這就是一顆GPU，而我們一次要出貨數千顆。」
他補充，光是一款整合36顆Grace CPU與72顆Blackwell GPU的電腦系統，目前銷售額就以每月27%的速度成長。
不過，黃仁勳的樂觀看法並不僅限於目前的銷售表現。他再次提到輝達明年的營收展望——這項指引是公司上個月公布再創歷史新高的季營收時所提出。當時，他首次表示公司明年營收可能成長70%。
黃仁勳周四再次表示，「我認為我們可以實現年增70%的成長。我們對此充滿信心。」。分析師預期，輝達本會計年度營收將達約4,000億美元。因此，如果明年成長70%，營收將達到約6,800億美元。
黃仁勳解釋了他為何充滿信心：輝達已深度嵌入AI的各個領域，因此他認為自己能夠「看見未來」。
「輝達運行每一個模型。每一家實驗室都可以使用我們的產品。」這其中包括Anthropic、OpenAI與Google的模型，以及各種開放權重模型。「我們是AI生態系的基礎平台，也是AI產業的基礎平台。」
輝達的觸角一路延伸，從記憶體晶片等供應商，到資料中心專案及新創公司，幾乎涵蓋AI產業各個環節。
黃仁勳談到，「我們正追蹤全球各地以GW計算的資料中心土地、電力供應與外殼建設。真的可以說是在追蹤地球上的一切。」(「外殼」是指資料中心建築完成基本結構、但尚未安裝電腦設備的階段。)
「想想我們所有的合作夥伴。有多少家新型雲端服務商正在向我們回報？有多少OEM廠商正在向我們回報？有多少雲端商正在向我們回報？有多少AI原生公司正在向我們回報？我們與所有人合作，所以某種程度上，我們知道所有事情發展到哪裡了。」
這番話也不可避免地引發外界對輝達所謂「循環交易」的疑問，也就是輝達投資某些公司，而這些公司之後又回頭購買輝達的產品。類似模式曾被認為是上一代網際網路基礎建設供應商，例如Lucent Technologies走向衰敗的原因之一。
對此，黃仁勳給出了簡單、甚至帶點調侃意味的回答。「這不是循環，因為我們投入一點點錢，卻有大量資金回來。」他接著開玩笑說，「我看著試算表，我們投入1美元，回來100美元。這算循環嗎？如果是，那我們就多做一點。」
黃仁勳強調，在輝達對這些公司進行任何投資之前，都會先確認對方已經擁有真正的客戶合約，並且能產生實際營收。整體而言，他已經看過價值約1,000億美元的這類合約。「我不承擔任何風險……我需要的是確定的事情。」
輝達在AI領域的強大地位究竟能否長期維持，仍有待時間證明。如果科技產業存在一條黃金法則，那就是所有龐大的事物最終都會遭到顛覆。就目前而言，即使黃仁勳也承認，AI產業目前很大一部分成長來自AI原生新創公司。這些公司正在籌集巨額資金，並將其中大部分投入自身AI應用。
隨著AI產業逐漸成熟，企業如何使用基礎設施與token的效率預期也將進一步提升。
但至少目前，輝達已將觸角伸進AI產業的各個領域，而黃仁勳也看好公司未來還將迎來另一個豐收年。
paras_en: TechCrunch reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told participants at Goldman Sachs' Communacopia + Technology Conference on Thursday (the 10th) how Nvidia's dominant position in AI and the company's revenue will continue to sustain record-breaking growth all the way through the end of next year.
He seems to have already seen the future.

Observers have long worried that as Nvidia faces increasingly fierce competition for GPUs and AI chips from all sides, the feast might eventually end. Competitors include hyperscale cloud providers (Amazon, Microsoft and Google, each developing its own chips), AI labs (Anthropic and OpenAI, also building their own chips), and recently listed startups such as Cerebras and Etched.

Huang said, "Most people think Nvidia is building a single chip. I mean, you need an airplane to ship what we build." He added that Nvidia is still working to shed the early‑stage perception of the company.

Nvidia invented the GPU, which at the time was mainly sold to consumers to boost PC gaming performance. "Now a GPU is no longer $399, it's $8.5 million. A GPU, fully linked via NVLink, contains 2 million parts, right? 250,000 kW. That's a GPU, and we ship thousands of them at a time."
He added that a single system integrating 36 Grace CPUs and 72 Blackwell GPUs is already growing sales at a 27 % monthly rate.

However, Huang's optimism is not limited to current sales performance. He reiterated Nvidia's revenue outlook for next year—a guidance that the company issued last month when it announced another record‑high quarterly revenue. At that time, he first said the company could see revenue grow by about 70 % next year.

Huang said again on Thursday, "I think we can achieve 70 % year‑over‑year growth. We are confident about it." Analysts expect Nvidia's revenue for the current fiscal year to reach roughly $400 billion. So, a 70 % increase next year would push revenue to about $680 billion.
Huang explained why he is confident: Nvidia is deeply embedded across all AI domains, which is why he believes he can "see the future."

"Nvidia runs every model. Every lab can use our products," he said, citing models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and various open‑weight models. "We are the foundational platform for the AI ecosystem and for the AI industry."
Nvidia's reach extends from memory‑chip suppliers to data‑center projects and startups, covering virtually every segment of the AI industry.

Huang said, "We are tracking data‑center land, power supply and shell construction worldwide measured in gigawatts. You could say we are tracking everything on the planet." (The "shell" refers to a data‑center building that has its basic structure completed but has not yet installed computing equipment.)

"Think about all our partners. How many new‑type cloud providers are reporting back to us? How many OEMs? How many cloud vendors? How many AI‑native companies? We work with everyone, so to some extent we know where everything is headed."

These remarks inevitably sparked questions about Nvidia's so‑called "circular trading," where Nvidia invests in certain companies that later buy Nvidia products. A similar model was once cited as one reason the previous generation of internet‑infrastructure suppliers, such as Lucent Technologies, declined.

In response, Huang gave a simple, slightly tongue‑in‑cheek answer: "It's not circular because we put in a little money and get a lot back." He joked, "I look at the spreadsheet: we invest $1 and get $100 back. Is that circular? If it is, then we'll do more of it."

Huang emphasized that before Nvidia makes any investment in these companies, it first verifies that they already have genuine customer contracts and can generate actual revenue. Overall, he has seen contracts of roughly $100 billion in value. "I take no risk… I need certainty," he said.

Whether Nvidia's strong position in AI can be sustained over the long term remains to be seen. If there is a golden rule in tech, it is that all massive entities eventually get disrupted. For now, even Huang admits that a large part of AI growth comes from AI‑native startups, which are raising huge funds and pouring most of them into their own AI applications.
As the AI industry matures, expectations for how efficiently enterprises use infrastructure and tokens are also expected to improve.
But at least for now, Nvidia has extended its reach into every corner of the AI sector, and Huang is confident the company will enjoy another bumper year ahead.

items.title: 「限制模式」失靈？宣稱能保護兒童卻沒做到 德州法官裁定TikTok誤導用戶
items.title_en: Texas Judge Rules TikTok Misled Users About ‘Restricted Mode’ Promising Child Protection
paras: 美國德州一名法官周四裁定，TikTok違反州消費者保護法，原因是該平台就如何過濾未成年人內容，以及「Restricted Mode」(限制模式)是否能有效阻擋不當內容，對使用者作出誤導性說明。這項裁決使TikTok在美國面臨的兒少安全與平台責任法律風險進一步升高。
德州政府於2025年1月對TikTok提起訴訟，指控該平台以兒童安全為訴求進行行銷，讓家長與年輕使用者相信TikTok已採取足夠措施保護未成年人免於接觸不適當內容。
根據法院裁決，德州方面指出，TikTok對使用者表示，凡違反平台「Community Guidelines」(社群規範)的內容都會遭到移除。然而，德州政府主張，TikTok內部實際上將部分相關內容分類為「hard to find」(難以找到)，而非「do not allow」(禁止發布)，因此這些內容仍能留在平台上。
德州法官Cory Liu認同州政府的主張，認定TikTok上述做法構成違反州消費者保護法。法院同時認定，德州已證明TikTok的「Restricted Mode」並未按照公司對外宣稱的方式運作，導致未成年人仍可能接觸到TikTok宣稱應被過濾掉的內容。
德州檢察長Ken Paxton辦公室表示，案件接下來將進入審判階段，屆時法院將決定TikTok可能面臨的罰款及其他救濟措施。Paxton辦公室預計，審判可能安排在下個月舉行。
TikTok目前尚未立即回應路透社在正常辦公時間以外提出的置評要求。
這項裁決也讓TikTok面臨的兒少保護爭議再次受到關注。德州的訴訟核心並非單純要求社群平台限制未成年人使用，而是聚焦TikTok對自身內容管理及兒少保護功能所作出的宣傳是否與實際運作情況相符。
若最終審判認定TikTok須承擔相關責任，除了可能面臨金錢處罰，也可能被要求採取其他補救措施，進一步改變平台對未成年人內容的過濾方式及安全功能的運作。
TikTok近年也持續面臨美國各州及個人使用者針對兒少安全、平台成癮性及心理健康等議題提出的法律挑戰。公司在今年8月同意和解3起由美國年輕人提起的訴訟，原告指控社群媒體公司刻意設計容易讓使用者成癮的平台功能，並因此損害年輕人的心理健康。
Meta(META-US)同樣面臨類似法律壓力。Meta在8月同意支付最高180億美元，以和解美國境內針對社群平台成癮性的相關索賠。這顯示美國社群媒體業者正面臨日益升高的法律與監管壓力，尤其是在未成年人保護、平台設計及內容管理等領域。
此次德州裁決的關鍵在於，法院認定TikTok對內容過濾機制及Restricted Mode功能的描述，可能讓使用者形成與實際情況不符的安全認知。對TikTok而言，這不僅涉及單一州的消費者保護訴訟，也可能增加其他州政府及使用者針對平台兒少安全措施提出法律主張的空間。
隨著案件進入審判階段，TikTok後續可能面臨的罰款金額及其他救濟措施將成為市場關注焦點，而法院最終裁決也可能對社群媒體平台如何宣傳兒少安全功能，以及業者是否必須確保相關功能確實按照宣稱內容運作，產生更廣泛的影響。
paras_en: A Texas judge on Thursday ruled that TikTok violated the state’s consumer protection law by giving misleading explanations to users about how it filters content for minors and whether “Restricted Mode” can effectively block inappropriate material. The ruling raises the legal risk for TikTok in the United States regarding child safety and platform liability.

The Texas government sued TikTok in January 2025, accusing the platform of marketing itself as child‑safe and leading parents and young users to believe TikTok had taken sufficient steps to shield minors from unsuitable content.

According to the court’s decision, Texas officials pointed out that TikTok tells users that any content violating its Community Guidelines will be removed. However, the state argues that TikTok internally classifies some of that content as “hard to find” rather than “do not allow,” allowing it to remain on the platform.

Judge Cory Liu of Texas agreed with the state’s claim, finding TikTok’s practice to be a violation of the state consumer protection law. The court also concluded that Texas had proven TikTok’s “Restricted Mode” does not operate as the company publicly claims, meaning minors could still encounter content the platform says should be filtered out.

The office of Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton said the case will now move to trial, at which point the court will decide any fines and other remedies TikTok may face. Paxton’s office expects the trial could be scheduled for next month.
TikTok has not yet responded to Reuters’ request for comment outside of normal business hours.

The ruling also brings renewed focus to the controversy over TikTok’s child‑protection measures. The core of Texas’s lawsuit is not simply to restrict minors’ use of the platform, but to examine whether TikTok’s publicity about its content‑management and child‑safety features matches its actual operations.

If the trial ultimately holds TikTok liable, the company could face monetary penalties and may be ordered to implement additional remedial actions, changing how it filters content for minors and how its safety features function.

TikTok has recently faced a wave of legal challenges across U.S. states and from individual users over child safety, platform addiction, and mental‑health concerns. In August, the company agreed to settle three lawsuits brought by American youths who alleged the social‑media giant deliberately designed addictive features that harmed their mental health.

Meta (META‑US) is confronting similar legal pressure. In August, Meta agreed to pay up to $18 billion to settle U.S. claims related to the addictive nature of its social platforms. This underscores the growing legal and regulatory pressure on U.S. social‑media firms, especially regarding minors’ protection, platform design, and content moderation.

The key takeaway from the Texas decision is that the court found TikTok’s descriptions of its content‑filtering mechanisms and Restricted Mode could give users a false sense of safety. For TikTok, this not only involves a single‑state consumer‑protection suit but could also open the door for other states and users to bring claims over the platform’s child‑safety measures.

As the case moves to trial, the potential fines and other remedies TikTok may face will attract market attention, and the final ruling could have broader implications for how social‑media platforms market child‑safety features and whether they must ensure those features operate as advertised.

items.title: 黃仁勳揭AI生意經：「製造問題」就是製造需求
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Unveils AI Business Strategy: “Creating Problems” Is Creating Demand
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳看好網路安全成為人工智慧（AI）的下一個主要應用領域。他指出，AI加速程式設計自動化，不僅提高程式碼遭利用的速度，也迫使企業更快修補漏洞，正從根本改變網路攻防節奏，並為AI算力創造新的高價值需求。
黃仁勳周四出席舊金山高盛科技會議時表示，網路安全很可能成為AI的下一個主要用例。隨著AI模型大幅降低程式碼編寫門檻，可遭利用的程式碼數量增加，漏洞被發現及攻擊的速度也隨之加快，企業必須以更高效率回應並完成修復。
AI改寫網路攻防節奏
黃仁勳認為，AI對電腦程式設計的自動化，正在對網路安全產業帶來結構性衝擊。當程式碼生成速度加快，潛在安全問題與修復需求也同步擴大，網路安全因此可能成為AI下一波重要需求來源。
他直言：「有什麼比製造問題更能創造需求的方式呢？哪家公司不希望自己的市場對產品趨之若鶩、排隊搶購？」不過，他也補充，完成這件事有負責任的方式，也有不那麼值得稱道的方式。
黃仁勳此時點名網路安全，正值市場持續檢視AI投資效益之際。輝達上月公布強勁的長期銷售展望，進一步鞏固華爾街對AI資料中心支出持續擴張的信心，但市場仍要求公司證明，龐大的資本支出確實能夠創造實際經濟效益。
在此背景下，網路安全不僅是AI技術帶來的新挑戰，也可能成為推升AI基礎設施與運算需求的新出口。
強調投資標的已有真實需求
另一方面，輝達持續積極投資與併購，也引發市場關注。公司上周宣布，將以約130億美元收購AI新創公司Hugging Face，進一步擴大在AI產業鏈的布局。
針對外界質疑輝達密集投資可能形成循環性需求，黃仁勳予以否認。他表示：「這不是循環，因為我們投入一點錢，回來的是很多錢。」
他並稱，市場逐漸發現，輝達投資的企業並非不良標的，因為公司會以專業投資者的角度評估機會，不會承擔不必要的風險。
黃仁勳進一步指出，輝達決定投資前，必須先看到「十拿九穩」的機會。對他而言，最重要的判斷標準，是潛在投資標的已經擁有真實市場需求，甚至已有客戶排隊等待其產品或服務。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang is bullish that cybersecurity will become the next major application area for artificial intelligence (AI). He noted that AI‑driven acceleration of software‑development automation not only speeds up the exploitation of code but also forces companies to patch vulnerabilities faster, fundamentally changing the rhythm of cyber offense and defense and generating new high‑value demand for AI compute power.

At the Goldman Sachs technology conference in San Francisco on Thursday, Huang said cybersecurity is very likely to be AI’s next major use case. As AI models dramatically lower the barrier to writing code, the amount of exploitable code rises, and the speed at which vulnerabilities are discovered and attacked also accelerates, compelling enterprises to respond and remediate with greater efficiency.
AI Rewrites the Cybersecurity Attack‑Defense Rhythm

Huang believes that AI’s automation of computer programming is delivering a structural shock to the cybersecurity industry. When code‑generation speed increases, the pool of potential security issues and the need for fixes expand in tandem, making cybersecurity a possible major source of AI‑driven demand.

He said bluntly, “What better way to create demand than to create problems? Which company doesn’t want its market to line up for its products, queuing to buy?” He added that there are responsible ways to achieve this and ways that are less commendable.

Huang singled out cybersecurity precisely as the market continues to scrutinize AI investment returns. Nvidia released a robust long‑term sales outlook last month, further cementing Wall Street’s confidence that AI data‑center spending will keep expanding, yet investors still want the company to prove that massive cap‑ex can translate into real economic benefits.
In this backdrop, cybersecurity is not only a new challenge brought by AI technology but could also become a fresh outlet for boosting demand for AI infrastructure and computing power.
Emphasizing that investment targets must have real demand

On the other hand, Nvidia’s continued aggressive investing and acquisitions have drawn market attention. The company announced last week that it will acquire AI startup Hugging Face for about $13 billion, further expanding its footprint in the AI value chain.

Addressing external doubts that Nvidia’s intensive investing might create a circular demand, Huang denied the notion. He said, “This is not a cycle, because we put in a little money and get back a lot of money.”

He also said the market is gradually realizing that the companies Nvidia backs are not bad assets, because the firm evaluates opportunities from a professional investor’s standpoint and avoids taking unnecessary risks.

Huang added that before Nvidia decides to invest, it must first see a “ten‑out‑of‑nine” opportunity. For him, the most important judgment criterion is that the potential target already has genuine market demand, even with customers queuing for its product or service.

items.title: 手機可跑3百億參數模型！繼CPU、GPU後　高通公布下一代Hexagon NPI
items.title_en: Phones can run 30‑billion‑parameter models! After CPUs and GPUs, Qualcomm unveils next‑gen Hexagon NPU
paras: 高通今(11)日正式公布新一代旗艦處理器Hexagon NPU，產品市場高級總監Cisco Cheng指出，智慧體AI將定義行動運算的下一個時代，行動AI晶片不只要算得快，還要能持續算、低延遲算、多工協同算。因此，這款為終端側智慧體AI打造的NPU導入兩項變化：Element Accelerator與更大的共享記憶體系統。
根據介紹，Element Accelerator針對Transformer工作負載優化，結合向量與純量運算單元：純量單元負責決策邏輯、路由與編排，向量單元提供高吞吐量AI運算；搭配Fast Action Loops與KV-Cache加速，支援最長32K上下文長度。
為降低資料搬運造成的延遲與功耗，共享記憶體容量較前代增加50%，讓模型狀態、上下文與KV-cache存放在更靠近加速器處，減少外部記憶體存取，使智慧體在長上下文、多工具呼叫下保持流暢回應。
高通並跟記憶體及模型廠商合作，把MoE混合專家模型引入終端側：300億參數模型每生成一個token僅活化約30億參數，以低功耗實現大模型體驗。精度方面支援INT2、INT4、INT8、FP8與FP16，其中INT4模型預填充效能最高提升50%，首token生成時間縮短至1.5秒。
高通布局的不只是AI加速器，而是圍繞終端側智慧體AI建構的運算體系，新一代旗艦平台詳情將於9月22日夏威夷驍龍峰會上公布。
paras_en: Qualcomm today (the 11th) officially announced its next‑generation flagship processor, the Hexagon NPU. Product senior director Cisco Cheng said that intelligent‑agent AI will define the next era of mobile computing, and mobile AI chips must not only compute fast but also compute continuously, with low latency and multitask collaboration. Accordingly, this NPU designed for edge‑side intelligent agents introduces two changes: an Element Accelerator and a larger shared memory system.

According to the briefing, the Element Accelerator is optimized for Transformer workloads and combines vector and scalar compute units: the scalar units handle decision logic, routing and orchestration, while the vector units deliver high‑throughput AI computation. Coupled with Fast Action Loops and KV‑Cache acceleration, it supports context lengths of up to 32K tokens.

To cut latency and power caused by data movement, the shared memory capacity is 50% larger than the previous generation, allowing model state, context and KV‑cache to reside closer to the accelerator. This reduces external memory accesses, keeping the intelligent agent responsive under long‑context and multi‑tool calls.

Qualcomm also partnered with memory and model vendors to bring MoE (mixture‑of‑experts) models to the edge: a 30‑billion‑parameter model activates only about 3‑billion parameters per generated token, delivering a large‑model experience at low power. It supports INT2, INT4, INT8, FP8 and FP16 precisions, with the INT4 model achieving up to a 50% boost in pre‑fill performance and reducing first‑token generation time to 1.5 seconds.

Qualcomm’s strategy is not just AI accelerators but an entire compute ecosystem built around edge‑side intelligent‑agent AI. Details of the next‑gen flagship platform will be revealed at the Snapdragon Summit in Hawaii on September 22.

items.title: 美股連漲3年養出「錯誤安全感」？專家建議重新平衡股債配置
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks' Three-Year Rally Breeds a "False Sense of Security"? Experts Advise Rebalancing Stock‑Bond Allocation
paras: 《CNBC》報導，全球債市遭到拋售、美股仍徘徊歷史高檔，加上地緣政治與通膨前景充滿不確定性，理財顧問認為，投資人可趁此時重新檢視資產配置，將投資組合調整回符合自身風險承受度的比例。
近年美股漲勢強勁，S&P 500指數在2023年至2025年分別上漲24%、23%及16%，連續3年繳出雙位數報酬，2026年迄今漲幅仍超過11%。隨著股票價值攀升，許多投資組合中的股票比重可能已高於原先設定，承擔的風險也隨之增加。
加州奧克蘭認證理財規劃師Cathy Curtis表示，不只重押科技股的投資人面臨這種情況，由於近年漲勢擴及多個產業，股票在多數投資組合中的占比都已提高。
與此同時，伊朗戰爭2月底爆發後，全球債市持續走弱。
投資人對通膨與政府債務的憂慮升高，推動多國公債殖利率升至多年高點。
由於債券價格與殖利率呈反向變動，美國10年期公債殖利率週三升至2023年以來最高，追蹤中長期美債價格的基金也同步下跌。
截至週三下午，iShares 7至10年期美國公債ETF (IEF-US) 今年以來下跌超過4%，Fidelity長期美國公債指數基金 (FNBGX-US)則跌逾5%。股債走勢分化，使部分投資人的資產配置進一步偏向股票。
所謂「再平衡」，是將投資組合恢復至原先設定的資產比例。以傳統60/40投資組合為例，若股票上漲使其比重超過60%，投資人可出售部分股票，並將資金轉入債券，使配置重新回到60%股票、40%債券。
紐奧良認證理財規劃師Jude Boudreaux指出，再平衡雖然不是最受關注的投資策略，卻相當實用。這種作法可將部分獲利從表現較好的資產轉往價格較低的資產，以有紀律的方式落實低買高賣。
在目前環境下，再平衡通常意味著降低股票比重、增加債券配置。雖然債券基金近期價格下跌，可能讓部分投資人卻步，但理財顧問認為，這也提供以較低價格增加債券部位的機會。
再平衡還能減少情緒對投資決策的干擾，避免投資人試圖預測市場時點。
近期油價突破每桶100美元，加劇通膨疑慮，美股週三隨之走低；伊朗戰爭、Fed新任主席、選舉週期、財政赤字及AI衝擊，也使市場不確定性升高。
Curtis表示，與其猜測哪些因素最終會主導市場，不如透過再平衡，將風險降回較合理的水準。
亞特蘭大認證理財規劃師Kamila Elliott也提醒，連續多年的強勁報酬可能使投資人產生錯誤的安全感，忘記市場仍可能下跌。
不過，再平衡並不代表全面賣出股票、將資金轉為現金，而是依據自身承受損失的能力，確認股票、債券與現金配置是否仍符合原定目標。
對接近退休的投資人而言，目前也可考慮將部分股票獲利轉入現金部位，以便退休初期若股市下跌，仍有資金可支應生活開銷。
理財顧問同時提醒投資人也不必一次完成所有調整，可透過新增資金、提款或兼顧稅務的交易，逐步將投資組合拉回目標比例。
paras_en: CNBC reports that global bond markets have been sold off while U.S. equities remain near historic highs, and with geopolitical tensions and inflation outlooks still uncertain, financial advisers say investors can use this moment to review asset allocation and shift portfolios back to a risk level that matches their tolerance.

U.S. equities have surged in recent years, with the S&P 500 up 24%, 23% and 16% in 2023, 2024 and 2025 respectively, delivering double‑digit returns for three straight years, and the year‑to‑date gain in 2026 is already over 11%. As stock values rise, the equity weight in many portfolios may now exceed the original target, increasing the risk taken.

Certified financial planner Cathy Curtis of Oakland, California, says it’s not only tech‑heavy investors facing this issue; because the rally has spread across multiple sectors, the stock share in most portfolios has risen.
At the same time, after the Iran war broke out at the end of February, global bond markets have continued to weaken.
Investors’ worries about inflation and government debt have pushed sovereign‑bond yields in many countries up to multi‑year highs.

Because bond prices move inversely to yields, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose on Wednesday to its highest level since 2023, and funds that track medium‑ to long‑term U.S. Treasury prices fell in tandem.

As of Wednesday afternoon, the iShares 7‑10 Year Treasury ETF (IEF‑US) is down more than 4% year‑to‑date, and the Fidelity Long‑Term Treasury Index Fund (FNBGX‑US) has slipped over 5%. The divergence between stocks and bonds has nudged some investors’ allocations further toward equities.

Rebalancing means restoring a portfolio to its original asset mix. For a traditional 60/40 portfolio, if equities rise above 60% of the mix, an investor can sell some stocks and move the proceeds into bonds to bring the allocation back to 60% stocks and 40% bonds.

New Orleans‑based certified planner Jude Boudreaux notes that while rebalancing isn’t the most talked‑about strategy, it is very practical. It lets investors shift part of the gains from better‑performing assets into lower‑priced ones, implementing a disciplined buy‑low, sell‑high approach.

In the current environment, rebalancing usually means cutting equity weight and adding bonds. Although bond funds have recently fallen in price, which may deter some investors, advisers say this also creates an opportunity to increase bond positions at lower cost.
Rebalancing also reduces the influence of emotions on investment decisions, helping investors avoid trying to time the market.

Oil prices recently broke $100 a barrel, heightening inflation concerns and pulling U.S. stocks lower on Wednesday; the Iran war, the Fed’s new chair, election cycles, fiscal deficits and AI disruptions have also raised market uncertainty.
Curtis says that instead of guessing which factor will ultimately drive the market, investors are better off rebalancing to bring risk back to a more reasonable level.
Atlanta‑based certified planner Kamila Elliott warns that years of strong returns can give investors a false sense of safety, causing them to forget that markets can still fall.

However, rebalancing does not mean selling all stocks and moving everything to cash; it means assessing whether the stock, bond and cash mix still aligns with the original target based on one’s loss‑tolerance capacity.
For investors nearing retirement, it may be prudent now to shift some equity gains into cash so that, if the market drops early in retirement, there will still be funds available for living expenses.

Advisers also remind investors that they don’t have to make all adjustments at once; they can gradually bring the portfolio back to target ratios through new contributions, withdrawals or tax‑efficient trades.

items.title: 日元近期強升非短線反彈？ 知名資管機構：低估修正啟動 回調即布局多頭
items.title_en: Yen's Recent Surge Not a Short-Term Bounce? Prominent Asset Management Firm: Undervaluation Correction Begins, Pullbacks Offer Bullish Positioning
paras: 日元近期強勢攀升，可能並非短期反彈，而是多年低估狀態進入更廣泛修正。歐洲資產管理公司Edmond de Rothschild多資產及對沖策略主管Michael Nizard最新表示，日元正擺脫長期由美日利差與套利交易主導的定價模式，重新回歸基本面。
Nizard說，「日元可能正在重新成為真正由基本面驅動的貨幣」，並稱未來回檔應視為重建，或是加碼日元多頭的機會。
本月以來日元已升值逾3%。日本央行(BOJ)加快緊縮的預期升溫，加上日本退休金資金配置可能改變，投資人紛紛平倉日元空單。美國財長貝森特此前更向交易員喊話「敢做空日元試試看」。
Nizard認為，近期美日聯合干預匯市同樣關鍵，市場原以為東京當局容忍日元貶值，聯合干預扭轉了預期，使日元貶值從「單向交易」變成漲跌風險並存的「雙向交易」。若日元續強，套利交易恐進一步平倉，槓桿下降將引發投資人拋售美債、信用債與股票；日本資金若回流國內，也將為全球債市帶來新波動。
他並提醒，修正過程不會是單方向，期間仍可能盤整甚至回弱，但只要趨勢不變，回檔都是布局多頭的機會。
基本面也出現改善。根據BOJ今(11)日公布的數據，8月企業商品價格指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於預期的7.4%，略低於7月修正後的7.7%，但月減0.2%。數據顯示，日企仍面臨能源、運輸、包裝與工資成本壓力，最終可能轉嫁消費者，推升通膨風險。
目前，市場普遍預估BOJ下周五(18日)將升息1碼至1.25%。
paras_en: The yen's recent strong climb may not be a short‑term rebound but rather a broader correction as it moves out of years of undervaluation. Michael Nizard, head of multi‑asset and hedge‑fund strategies at European asset manager Edmond de Rothschild, said the yen is shedding the pricing model long dominated by US‑Japan interest‑rate differentials and arbitrage trades, and is returning to fundamentals.

Nizard said, “The yen may be becoming a currency truly driven by fundamentals,” and added that any future pull‑back should be seen as a rebuilding phase, or an opportunity to add to long yen positions.

Since the start of the month the yen has appreciated by more than 3%. Expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten faster are heating up, and possible changes in Japanese pension fund allocations are prompting investors to unwind short yen positions. U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen earlier urged traders, “If you dare to short the yen, give it a try.”

Nizard sees the recent joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market as equally pivotal. The market had assumed Tokyo tolerated yen depreciation; the coordinated intervention flipped that expectation, turning yen weakness from a one‑way trade into a two‑way trade with both upside and downside risk. If the yen keeps strengthening, arbitrage positions are likely to be further unwound, reduced leverage could trigger investors to sell U.S. Treasuries, credit bonds and equities; a repatriation of Japanese capital would also introduce new volatility to global bond markets.

He cautioned that the correction will not be unidirectional; there may be periods of consolidation or even temporary weakness, but as long as the trend remains intact, each pull‑back is an opportunity to build long positions.

Fundamentals are also improving. According to data released by the BOJ today (Nov 11), the August corporate goods price index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑on‑year, above the 7.4% forecast, slightly below the revised July figure of 7.7%, and fell 0.2% month‑on‑month. The data show Japanese firms still face pressure from energy, transport, packaging and wage costs, which could eventually be passed on to consumers, raising inflation risks.
Currently the market broadly expects the BOJ to raise rates by one basis point to 1.25% on Friday, the 18th.

items.title: iPhone Duo就是跟風華為、三星做的！古爾曼爆料：庫克2020年亞洲行後拍板
items.title_en: iPhone Duo is just following Huawei and Samsung! Gurman reveals: Cook made the decision after his 2020 Asia tour
paras: 《彭博資訊》知名科技記者古爾曼(Mark Gurman)近日爆料指出，受華為、三星摺疊手機影響，蘋果前執行長庫克最終拍板定下了要堅持做摺疊機的戰略方向。
古爾曼表示，蘋果內部早已秘密啟動摺疊螢幕技術研發，而計畫真正提速的轉捩點出現在2020年前後。當時庫克結束亞洲行，在中國等市場親眼看到大量消費者上手華為、三星摺疊手機，當下便判定蘋果必須入局，返美後立刻推動專案加速。
不過，在庫克正式立項之前，蘋果團隊已就相關技術機密進行多年研發。公開資料顯示，蘋果至少最早在2016年就申請了可摺疊相關技術專利。
另有知情人士透露，甚至在2019年三星發表首款Galaxy Fold、把摺疊螢幕推向大眾市場之前，蘋果核心硬體團隊就已在研究摺疊螢幕、鉸鏈與整機結構。
最終，蘋果週三(10日)在加州Apple Park賈伯斯劇院舉辦 「亮新篇，來耀眼」秋季發布會，籌備多年的首款摺疊機iPhone Duo終於正式亮相。
paras_en: Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman recently revealed that, influenced by Huawei and Samsung folding phones, former Apple CEO Tim Cook ultimately decided to stick with a folding phone strategy.

Gurman says Apple had already secretly started R&D on folding-screen technology, and the real acceleration point came around 2020. At that time, after finishing his Asia tour, Cook saw many consumers in China and other markets using Huawei and Samsung folding phones, and decided Apple must enter the market; upon returning to the US he immediately pushed the project to speed up.

However, before Cook formally launched the project, Apple’s team had been researching the related technology secrets for years. Public records show Apple filed folding‑related patents as early as 2016.

Another insider said that even before Samsung unveiled its first Galaxy Fold in 2019 and brought folding screens to the mass market, Apple’s core hardware team was already studying folding screens, hinges, and full‑device architecture.

Finally, on Wednesday the 10th, Apple held its “Bright New Chapter, Shining Ahead” autumn launch at the Steve Jobs Theater in Apple Park, California, where the long‑awaited first folding iPhone, the iPhone Duo, was officially unveiled.

items.title: 全球富豪榜洗牌！美國科技富豪首度全面霸榜 LVMH創辦人跌出前10
items.title_en: Global Billionaires List Shuffles! U.S. Tech Tycoons Dominate for First Time, LVMH Founder Falls Out of Top 10
paras: 法國精品業大亨、LVMH創辦人阿諾特(Bernard Arnault)周四(10日)跌出全球前十大億萬富豪榜外，讓這份排行榜首度清一色由美國富豪包辦，其中多數為科技業億萬富豪。
根據彭博億萬富豪指數(Bloomberg Billionaires Index)，阿諾特最新身價降至1430億美元，排名跌至96歲的慈善家、波克夏(Berkshire Hathaway)董事長巴菲特(Warren Buffett)之後。

馬斯克身價近9200億美元 遙遙領先

全球首富、SpaceX(SPCX-US)和特斯拉(TS;A-US)創辦人馬斯克以9188億美元身價遙遙領先，前十名還包括Google(GOOGL-US)兩名創辦人佩吉(Larry Page)及布林(Sergey Brin)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)、戴爾科技(DELL-US)創辦人戴爾(Michael Dell)等科技公司創辦人。這是彭博億萬富豪指數2012年推出以來，全球前十大富豪首次全數由美國人包辦。
77歲的阿諾特今年來身價明顯下跌，財富縮水650億美元，為全球前500大富豪中減幅最大的，原因是中東戰爭重創奢侈品需求， LVMH旗下受影響的包括Dior、Louis Vuitton和Tiffany等精品品牌，以及Dom Pérignon香檳、Hennessy干邑等高級酒類產品。
與此同時，美國股市標普500指數今年已上漲11%，人工智慧(AI)相關需求帶動下，科技業帶動，成為推升大盤的重要力量。

曾短暫登上全球首富寶座

自2017年3月22日起，阿諾特一直名列全球十大富豪，2022年12月之後，還曾短暫多次登上全球首富寶座。他是第一位登上全球首富寶座的非北美人士，也是唯一一位消費產業大亨，迄今再也沒有其他非北美人士登上這個寶座。
阿諾特締造這項紀錄的時代，精品業景況與如今大不相同。當時中國消費者仍是精品銷售的重要推手，LVMH等企業也從疫情封控解除後累積的消費需求中獲益。
LVMH股價在2023年4月創下歷史新高，但後來由於中國等地產品需求疲弱、美國關稅帶來的不確定性，以及部分市場酒類消費下滑，股價欲振乏力。目前阿諾特的財富排名，僅高於沃爾瑪(Walmart)(WMT-US)第二代繼承人Jim Walton。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: French luxury magnate and LVMH founder Bernard Arnault fell out of the global top‑ten billionaires list on Thursday (the 10th), making this the first time the ranking is entirely occupied by American billionaires, most of whom are from the tech sector.
According to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, Arnault’s net worth has slipped to $143 billion, dropping behind 96‑year‑old philanthropist and Berkshire Hathaway chairman Warren Buffett.

Elon Musk, founder of SpaceX (SPCX‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US), leads with a net worth of $918.8 billion. The rest of the top ten include Google (GOOGL‑US) co‑founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin, Amazon (AMZN‑US) founder Jeff Bezos, Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) founder Michael Dell and other tech entrepreneurs. This is the first time since the Bloomberg Billionaires Index was launched in 2012 that the world’s ten richest are all Americans.

The 77‑year‑old Arnault has seen his wealth shrink sharply this year, losing $65 billion – the largest percentage drop among the world’s top‑500 billionaires – as the Middle‑East conflict has battered luxury‑goods demand. LVMH brands hit hard include Dior, Louis Vuitton and Tiffany, as well as premium drinks such as Dom Pérignon champagne and Hennessy cognac.
At the same time, the U.S. S&P 500 index is up about 11% this year, buoyed by AI‑driven demand and the tech sector, which has become a key engine lifting the market.

Arnault briefly topped the world’s richest list. Starting on March 22, 2017 he remained in the global top ten, and after December 2022 he briefly reclaimed the number‑one spot several times. He was the first non‑North‑American to reach the top and the only consumer‑industry magnate to do so, and no other non‑North‑American has since held the title.

When Arnault set that record, the luxury sector looked very different. Chinese consumers were then a major driver of luxury sales, and companies like LVMH benefited from pent‑up demand after pandemic lockdowns were lifted.

LVMU’s share price hit a historic high in April 2023, but later faltered as demand weakened in China and elsewhere, U.S. tariff uncertainty rose, and some alcoholic‑beverage markets softened, leaving the stock struggling to regain momentum. Arnault now ranks just above Walmart (WMT‑US) heir Jim Walton.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 108億天價薪酬也留不住！Meta挖來AI頂尖人才Tulloch不到一年轉投Anthropic
items.title_en: Even a $10.8 Billion Salary Can't Keep Him: Meta Lures Top AI Talent Tulloch, Who Leaves for Anthropic in Under a Year
paras: Meta Platforms(META-US)再度傳出頂尖AI人才出走。曾被Meta以最高可能達15億美元(約新台幣486億元)薪酬方案挖角的AI研究員Andrew Tulloch，在重返Meta不到1年後決定離職，據報將於下周加入Anthropic的推理與效能團隊，主要負責模型訓練與推理效能等工作。更受關注的是，他離開Meta的時間點恰逢Meta剛推出AI個人助理Muse，Tulloch曾參與相關研發，令外界再次關注Meta高薪搶人的人才策略究竟能否留住頂尖研究人員。
Tulloch此次離職距離Meta 9月8日正式推出Muse僅約1至2天。Meta表示，Muse是一款可自主執行任務的AI代理人，能夠處理電子郵件、行程預訂、購物、填寫表格等工作，並可在獲得用戶授權後連結電子郵件、行事曆、支付、健康、購物及智慧家庭等應用程式。Muse目前先在美國推出，可透過獨立App及WhatsApp使用，基本版本免費，進階訂閱方案則分別為每月20美元及100美元。
Meta將Muse視為執行執行長祖克柏「個人超級智能」願景的重要產品，希望讓AI從單純回答問題的聊天機器人，進一步成為能替用戶實際完成工作的個人代理人。Muse背後採用Meta的Muse Spark模型系列，其中Muse Spark 1.2在8月推出，主打程式設計、多模態理解及工具使用能力，Meta也持續更新模型，以強化智能體及程式設計任務表現。

然而，Muse推出之際，Meta內部對產品可靠性與安全性的疑慮仍未完全消失。路透社引述Meta內部測試資訊指出，部分員工曾遇到登入問題、任務執行失敗及監控功能中斷等情況，也曾發現AI代理人可能繞過部分安全限制並接觸私人資料。Meta此前原定4月推出Muse，但為了進一步強化安全性而延後發布。路透社另指出，Meta內部與AI相關的重大技術及安全事故較去年增加約40%，處理相關事故所耗費的人力時間也增加約70%。
Tulloch的離開因此格外受到關注。據《華爾街日報》及Business Insider報導，Tulloch將離開Meta並加入Anthropic的推理與效能團隊，工作重點包括優化AI模型訓練及提升模型與用戶互動時的效能。Tulloch過去曾參與OpenAI的GPT-4o、GPT-4.5及o3等模型工作，如今轉投Anthropic，也意味著頂尖AI人才之間的競爭仍在持續升溫。
Tulloch並不是第一次離開Meta。他在2012年至2023年間於Meta工作約11年，從機器學習工程師一路升至Distinguished Engineer，參與多項核心AI基礎建設，包括PyTorch CUDA、ResNet-50、FBGEMM、資料中心深度學習推理、端側推理、模型量化及AITemplate等工作。
其中，他曾參與將ResNet-50在ImageNet上的訓練時間壓縮至約1小時，利用256顆GPU達到約90%的擴展效率；同時也參與FBGEMM高效能運算算子庫的開發，相關技術主要應用於推薦系統、量化運算及生成式AI。這類經驗讓Tulloch的價值不僅在於開發模型，更在於如何讓大型AI模型更有效率地訓練、推理及部署。
2023年離開Meta後，Tulloch加入OpenAI，參與GPT-4o、GPT-4.5及o3等模型的訓練工作，之後又與OpenAI前技術長Mira Murati共同創辦Thinking Machines Lab，成為這家備受矚目的AI新創公司聯合創辦人之一。
真正讓Tulloch成為Meta搶人大戰焦點的，是2025年的那場AI人才爭奪戰。Meta在Llama 4表現未達市場期待後，祖克柏大幅加碼AI戰略，並透過14.3億美元投資Scale AI，讓其創辦人Alexandr Wang加入Meta，進一步組建超級智能團隊。Meta隨後對OpenAI、Anthropic、Google及多家AI新創展開大規模人才招募。
Thinking Machines Lab也因此成為Meta積極爭取的對象。據《華爾街日報》報導，祖克柏曾試圖收購Thinking Machines，但遭Murati拒絕後，Meta轉而接觸公司十多名員工，希望直接招攬頂尖研究人員。其中Tulloch成為主要目標之一，祖克柏與Wang均曾積極遊說他加入Meta。
當時市場流傳Meta提供的薪酬方案最高可能達15億美元，期限至少6年，若將獎金及Meta股價大幅上漲等條件計算在內，潛在總價值甚至可能突破這一數字。不過，Meta發言人當時稱相關描述「不準確且荒謬」，而Axios後續報導也指出，Tulloch最終實際獲得的薪酬方案低於先前流傳的15億美元版本。換言之，15億美元應視為外界報導的最高潛在價值，而非已獲證實的實際薪資。
更具戲劇性的是，Tulloch最初其實拒絕了Meta的邀請。當時Thinking Machines的員工也沒有接受Meta的挖角。直到2025年10月，Tulloch才以個人因素為由離開Thinking Machines，重新加入Meta，並進入由Wang領導的TBD Labs。
從2025年10月回到Meta，到2026年9月離開，Tulloch第二段Meta生涯不到1年。如今他再次轉投競爭對手Anthropic，也讓Meta以高額薪酬吸引頂尖AI人才的策略面臨新的考驗。
而Tulloch並不是近期Meta高薪招募人才中第一位離開的核心人物。另一名AI研究員余家輝(Jiahui Yu)今年8月宣布離開Meta創業，時間點同樣發生在Muse Spark 1.2推出後不久。余家輝此前參與Meta的TBD Labs及多模態AI工作，其離開也被視為Meta頂尖AI人才流動加速的另一個案例。

更值得注意的是，Tulloch此次離開也反映出這場人才爭奪戰並非Meta單方面面臨壓力。AI頂尖研究人員正在OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta及Google等公司之間快速流動，Thinking Machines近期甚至出現多名共同創辦人改換陣營的情況。據《華爾街日報》報導，Tulloch是近期第三名轉換職務的Thinking Machines聯合創辦人，另外兩人分別前往Google及Meta。
對已經擁有極高市場身價的AI研究人員而言，薪酬可能已經不是唯一甚至不是最重要的考量。研究方向、算力資源、團隊成員、決策自主權、產品落地速度，以及自己對AI發展路線的判斷，都可能影響一名頂尖研究員究竟選擇大型科技公司、AI實驗室或自行創業。
Meta目前仍在大舉投資AI基礎建設，並希望藉由Muse等產品把龐大的社群平台用戶轉化為AI服務的使用者。路透社指出，Meta預計今年AI晶片及相關基礎建設支出將超過1300億美元，Muse則被視為將龐大AI投資轉化為新商業模式的重要嘗試。
與此同時，Anthropic也在快速擴張。Tulloch轉投Anthropic之際，該公司正面臨與OpenAI、Google及Meta的激烈競爭，並準備推進上市計畫。這意味著Tulloch加入Anthropic，不只是單純換工作，也可能進一步強化Anthropic在模型訓練、推理效能及AI代理人領域的技術能力。
從Meta、OpenAI到Anthropic，AI產業如今爭奪的已不只是模型參數、GPU數量或資本，而是少數能真正將模型能力轉化為大規模產品與基礎設施的核心人才。當這些人才仍然稀缺時，超高薪酬自然具有強大吸引力，但Tulloch的案例也顯示，巨額報價可以把人才挖來，卻不一定能讓人才長期留下。
對Meta而言，Tulloch與余家輝先後離開，恰好發生在Muse及Muse Spark持續推進之際，無疑讓祖克柏的超級智能豪賭再添變數。當AI人才仍像自由球員般在不同實驗室之間選擇薪酬、算力、研究方向與舞台時，Meta能否將這些明星研究人員真正整合成穩定且長期的AI戰力，恐怕會比單純砸下多少億美元更加關鍵。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) is again seeing top AI talent depart. AI researcher Andrew Tulloch, who was poached by Meta with a compensation package that could reach up to $1.5 billion (about NT$48.6 billion), decided to quit less than a year after returning to the company and is reported to join Anthropic’s inference and performance team next week, focusing on model training and inference efficiency. His departure is especially noteworthy because it comes just as Meta launched its AI personal assistant Muse, a project Tulloch helped develop, reigniting questions about whether Meta’s high‑pay talent‑snatching strategy can actually retain elite researchers.

Tulloch’s exit comes just one to two days after Meta officially rolled out Muse on September 8. Meta describes Muse as an autonomous AI agent that can handle email, schedule appointments, shop, fill out forms and, with user permission, link to email, calendar, payment, health, shopping and smart‑home apps. Muse is initially available only in the United States via a standalone app and WhatsApp, with a free basic tier and premium subscriptions priced at $20 and $100 per month respectively.

Meta views Muse as a key product for CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s “personal super‑intelligence” vision, aiming to evolve AI from a simple question‑answering chatbot into a personal agent that can actually get work done for users. Muse runs on Meta’s Muse Spark model series, with Muse Spark 1.2 released in August, emphasizing programming, multimodal understanding and tool‑use capabilities; Meta continues to update the model to boost performance on agent and coding tasks.

However, internal concerns about Muse’s reliability and safety have not fully disappeared. Reuters, citing internal testing data, reported that some employees experienced login failures, task execution errors and monitoring outages, and that the AI agent sometimes bypassed security restrictions to access private data. Meta had originally planned a April launch but delayed it to strengthen safety. Reuters also noted that internal AI‑related technical and safety incidents rose about 40% year‑on‑year, with the manpower required to handle them up by roughly 70%.

Tulloch’s departure therefore attracted extra attention. According to the Wall Street Journal and Business Insider, he will leave Meta for Anthropic’s inference and performance team, where his work will focus on optimizing AI model training and improving performance during user interaction. Tulloch previously contributed to OpenAI’s GPT‑4o, GPT‑4.5 and o3 models; his move to Anthropic underscores the intensifying competition for top AI talent.

This is not Tulloch’s first exit from Meta. He spent roughly 11 years at the company from 2012 to 2023, rising from machine‑learning engineer to Distinguished Engineer and working on core AI infrastructure such as PyTorch CUDA, ResNet‑50, FBGEMM, data‑center deep‑learning inference, edge inference, model quantization and AITemplate.

Among his achievements, he helped shrink ResNet‑50’s ImageNet training time to about one hour using 256 GPUs with roughly 90% scaling efficiency, and contributed to the high‑performance FBGEMM operator library, which powers recommendation systems, quantized computation and generative AI. This experience makes Tulloch valuable not just for building models but for making large AI models train, infer and deploy more efficiently.

After leaving Meta in 2023, Tulloch joined OpenAI, working on the training of GPT‑4o, GPT‑4.5 and o3, and later co‑founded Thinking Machines Lab with former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, becoming a co‑founder of the high‑profile AI startup.

What truly put Tulloch in the spotlight of Meta’s talent‑war was the 2025 AI talent scramble. After Llama 4 underperformed, Zuckerberg dramatically ramped up the AI strategy, investing $1.43 billion in Scale AI and bringing its founder Alexandr Wang into Meta to build a super‑intelligence team. Meta then launched a massive recruitment drive targeting OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and numerous AI startups.

Thinking Machines Lab became a prime target for Meta’s poaching. The Wall Street Journal reported that Zuckerberg tried to acquire the startup, but Murati declined, prompting Meta to reach out directly to more than a dozen of its employees in hopes of hiring top researchers. Tulloch was a key target, with both Zuckerberg and Wang actively courting him.

At the time, market rumors suggested Meta’s compensation package could be as high as $1.5 billion over at least six years, potentially exceeding that figure when bonuses and a soaring Meta stock price are factored in. Meta’s spokesperson called those descriptions “inaccurate and absurd,” and Axios later reported that Tulloch’s actual package was lower than the rumored $1.5 billion version. In other words, the $1.5 billion figure reflects the maximum potential value reported by the media, not a confirmed salary.

More dramatically, Tulloch initially turned down Meta’s offer, and Thinking Machines employees also resisted the poaching. It was not until October 2025 that Tulloch left Thinking Machines for personal reasons, re‑joined Meta, and entered the Wang‑led TBD Labs.

From his return in October 2025 to his departure in September 2026, Tulloch’s second stint at Meta lasted less than a year. His latest move to a rival, Anthropic, puts Meta’s high‑pay talent‑acquisition strategy under fresh scrutiny.

Tulloch is not the first recent Meta hire to leave after receiving a big payout. AI researcher Jiahui Yu announced in August that he was leaving Meta to start his own venture, also shortly after the launch of Muse Spark 1.2. Yu had worked on Meta’s TBD Labs and multimodal AI projects, and his exit is seen as another sign of accelerating turnover among Meta’s top AI talent.

Tulloch’s exit also highlights that the talent war is not a one‑sided pressure on Meta. Top AI researchers are moving quickly among OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google and other firms, and Thinking Machines has recently seen several co‑founders switch sides. The Wall Street Journal notes that Tulloch is the third recent Thinking Machines co‑founder to change jobs, with the other two heading to Google and Meta respectively.

For AI researchers who already command very high market value, compensation is no longer the sole—or even the primary—consideration. Research direction, compute resources, team composition, decision‑making autonomy, product rollout speed, and personal views on AI’s future trajectory all influence whether a top researcher joins a big tech firm, an AI lab, or starts a company.

Meta continues to pour massive investment into AI infrastructure and hopes products like Muse will convert its huge social‑media user base into AI‑service customers. Reuters notes that Meta expects to spend more than $130 billion this year on AI chips and related infrastructure, and Muse is seen as a key attempt to turn that investment into a new business model.

At the same time, Anthropic is expanding rapidly. As Tulloch moves to Anthropic, the company is locked in fierce competition with OpenAI, Google and Meta and is preparing for an IPO. His arrival therefore not only represents a job change but could also boost Anthropic’s capabilities in model training, inference performance and AI‑agent technology.

From Meta to OpenAI to Anthropic, the AI industry is now fighting over more than model parameters, GPU counts or capital—it’s battling for the few individuals who can truly turn model capabilities into large‑scale products and infrastructure. When such talent remains scarce, astronomical salaries are naturally alluring, yet Tulloch’s case shows that huge offers can attract talent without guaranteeing long‑term retention.

For Meta, the departures of Tulloch and Jiahui Yu, both occurring as Muse and Muse Spark continue to roll out, add another variable to Zuckerberg’s super‑intelligence gamble. As AI talent behaves like free agents, choosing between pay, compute, research focus and platform, Meta’s ability to integrate these star researchers into a stable, long‑term AI force may prove far more critical than simply spending billions.

items.title: 黃仁勳看見AI未來？輝達明年營收為何能大增70%
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Envisions an AI Future? Why Nvidia Can Boost Revenue by 70% Next Year
paras: 《TechCrunch》報導，輝達執行長黃仁勳周四(10日)向高盛科技論壇Communacopia + Technology Conference與會者說明，輝達在AI領域的主導地位及公司營收，何以將持續維持創紀錄的成長勢頭，並一路延續至明年底。
他似乎已經看到了未來。
外界一直擔心，隨著輝達面臨來自各方對GPU與AI晶片日益激烈的競爭，這場盛宴是否終將結束。競爭者包括超大規模雲端服務商(亞馬遜、微軟與Google，各自都在開發自有晶片)、AI實驗室(Anthropic與OpenAI，也都在打造自己的晶片)，以及近期上市的競爭對手Cerebras和Etched等新創。
黃仁勳談到，「大多數人認為輝達是在打造一顆晶片。我的意思是，你需要用飛機才能運送我們所打造的東西。」他補充，輝達仍在努力擺脫外界對公司早期的既有印象。
輝達發明了GPU，而在當時，GPU主要銷售給消費者，用來提升PC遊戲效能。「現在一顆GPU已經不是399美元了，而是850萬美元。一顆GPU，全部透過NVLink連接在一起，有200萬個零件，對吧？250,000kW。這就是一顆GPU，而我們一次要出貨數千顆。」
他補充，光是一款整合36顆Grace CPU與72顆Blackwell GPU的電腦系統，目前銷售額就以每月27%的速度成長。
不過，黃仁勳的樂觀看法並不僅限於目前的銷售表現。他再次提到輝達明年的營收展望——這項指引是公司上個月公布再創歷史新高的季營收時所提出。當時，他首次表示公司明年營收可能成長70%。
黃仁勳周四再次表示，「我認為我們可以實現年增70%的成長。我們對此充滿信心。」。分析師預期，輝達本會計年度營收將達約4,000億美元。因此，如果明年成長70%，營收將達到約6,800億美元。
黃仁勳解釋了他為何充滿信心：輝達已深度嵌入AI的各個領域，因此他認為自己能夠「看見未來」。
「輝達運行每一個模型。每一家實驗室都可以使用我們的產品。」這其中包括Anthropic、OpenAI與Google的模型，以及各種開放權重模型。「我們是AI生態系的基礎平台，也是AI產業的基礎平台。」
輝達的觸角一路延伸，從記憶體晶片等供應商，到資料中心專案及新創公司，幾乎涵蓋AI產業各個環節。
黃仁勳談到，「我們正追蹤全球各地以GW計算的資料中心土地、電力供應與外殼建設。真的可以說是在追蹤地球上的一切。」(「外殼」是指資料中心建築完成基本結構、但尚未安裝電腦設備的階段。)
「想想我們所有的合作夥伴。有多少家新型雲端服務商正在向我們回報？有多少OEM廠商正在向我們回報？有多少雲端商正在向我們回報？有多少AI原生公司正在向我們回報？我們與所有人合作，所以某種程度上，我們知道所有事情發展到哪裡了。」
這番話也不可避免地引發外界對輝達所謂「循環交易」的疑問，也就是輝達投資某些公司，而這些公司之後又回頭購買輝達的產品。類似模式曾被認為是上一代網際網路基礎建設供應商，例如Lucent Technologies走向衰敗的原因之一。
對此，黃仁勳給出了簡單、甚至帶點調侃意味的回答。「這不是循環，因為我們投入一點點錢，卻有大量資金回來。」他接著開玩笑說，「我看著試算表，我們投入1美元，回來100美元。這算循環嗎？如果是，那我們就多做一點。」
黃仁勳強調，在輝達對這些公司進行任何投資之前，都會先確認對方已經擁有真正的客戶合約，並且能產生實際營收。整體而言，他已經看過價值約1,000億美元的這類合約。「我不承擔任何風險……我需要的是確定的事情。」
輝達在AI領域的強大地位究竟能否長期維持，仍有待時間證明。如果科技產業存在一條黃金法則，那就是所有龐大的事物最終都會遭到顛覆。就目前而言，即使黃仁勳也承認，AI產業目前很大一部分成長來自AI原生新創公司。這些公司正在籌集巨額資金，並將其中大部分投入自身AI應用。
隨著AI產業逐漸成熟，企業如何使用基礎設施與token的效率預期也將進一步提升。
但至少目前，輝達已將觸角伸進AI產業的各個領域，而黃仁勳也看好公司未來還將迎來另一個豐收年。
paras_en: TechCrunch reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told participants at Goldman Sachs' Communacopia + Technology Conference on Thursday (the 10th) how Nvidia's dominant position in AI and the company's revenue will continue to sustain record-breaking growth all the way through the end of next year.
He seems to have already seen the future.

Observers have long worried that as Nvidia faces increasingly fierce competition for GPUs and AI chips from all sides, the feast might eventually end. Competitors include hyperscale cloud providers (Amazon, Microsoft and Google, each developing its own chips), AI labs (Anthropic and OpenAI, also building their own chips), and recently listed startups such as Cerebras and Etched.

Huang said, "Most people think Nvidia is building a single chip. I mean, you need an airplane to ship what we build." He added that Nvidia is still working to shed the early‑stage perception of the company.

Nvidia invented the GPU, which at the time was mainly sold to consumers to boost PC gaming performance. "Now a GPU is no longer $399, it's $8.5 million. A GPU, fully linked via NVLink, contains 2 million parts, right? 250,000 kW. That's a GPU, and we ship thousands of them at a time."
He added that a single system integrating 36 Grace CPUs and 72 Blackwell GPUs is already growing sales at a 27 % monthly rate.

However, Huang's optimism is not limited to current sales performance. He reiterated Nvidia's revenue outlook for next year—a guidance that the company issued last month when it announced another record‑high quarterly revenue. At that time, he first said the company could see revenue grow by about 70 % next year.

Huang said again on Thursday, "I think we can achieve 70 % year‑over‑year growth. We are confident about it." Analysts expect Nvidia's revenue for the current fiscal year to reach roughly $400 billion. So, a 70 % increase next year would push revenue to about $680 billion.
Huang explained why he is confident: Nvidia is deeply embedded across all AI domains, which is why he believes he can "see the future."

"Nvidia runs every model. Every lab can use our products," he said, citing models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and various open‑weight models. "We are the foundational platform for the AI ecosystem and for the AI industry."
Nvidia's reach extends from memory‑chip suppliers to data‑center projects and startups, covering virtually every segment of the AI industry.

Huang said, "We are tracking data‑center land, power supply and shell construction worldwide measured in gigawatts. You could say we are tracking everything on the planet." (The "shell" refers to a data‑center building that has its basic structure completed but has not yet installed computing equipment.)

"Think about all our partners. How many new‑type cloud providers are reporting back to us? How many OEMs? How many cloud vendors? How many AI‑native companies? We work with everyone, so to some extent we know where everything is headed."

These remarks inevitably sparked questions about Nvidia's so‑called "circular trading," where Nvidia invests in certain companies that later buy Nvidia products. A similar model was once cited as one reason the previous generation of internet‑infrastructure suppliers, such as Lucent Technologies, declined.

In response, Huang gave a simple, slightly tongue‑in‑cheek answer: "It's not circular because we put in a little money and get a lot back." He joked, "I look at the spreadsheet: we invest $1 and get $100 back. Is that circular? If it is, then we'll do more of it."

Huang emphasized that before Nvidia makes any investment in these companies, it first verifies that they already have genuine customer contracts and can generate actual revenue. Overall, he has seen contracts of roughly $100 billion in value. "I take no risk… I need certainty," he said.

Whether Nvidia's strong position in AI can be sustained over the long term remains to be seen. If there is a golden rule in tech, it is that all massive entities eventually get disrupted. For now, even Huang admits that a large part of AI growth comes from AI‑native startups, which are raising huge funds and pouring most of them into their own AI applications.
As the AI industry matures, expectations for how efficiently enterprises use infrastructure and tokens are also expected to improve.
But at least for now, Nvidia has extended its reach into every corner of the AI sector, and Huang is confident the company will enjoy another bumper year ahead.

items.title: 「限制模式」失靈？宣稱能保護兒童卻沒做到 德州法官裁定TikTok誤導用戶
items.title_en: Texas Judge Rules TikTok Misled Users About ‘Restricted Mode’ Promising Child Protection
paras: 美國德州一名法官周四裁定，TikTok違反州消費者保護法，原因是該平台就如何過濾未成年人內容，以及「Restricted Mode」(限制模式)是否能有效阻擋不當內容，對使用者作出誤導性說明。這項裁決使TikTok在美國面臨的兒少安全與平台責任法律風險進一步升高。
德州政府於2025年1月對TikTok提起訴訟，指控該平台以兒童安全為訴求進行行銷，讓家長與年輕使用者相信TikTok已採取足夠措施保護未成年人免於接觸不適當內容。
根據法院裁決，德州方面指出，TikTok對使用者表示，凡違反平台「Community Guidelines」(社群規範)的內容都會遭到移除。然而，德州政府主張，TikTok內部實際上將部分相關內容分類為「hard to find」(難以找到)，而非「do not allow」(禁止發布)，因此這些內容仍能留在平台上。
德州法官Cory Liu認同州政府的主張，認定TikTok上述做法構成違反州消費者保護法。法院同時認定，德州已證明TikTok的「Restricted Mode」並未按照公司對外宣稱的方式運作，導致未成年人仍可能接觸到TikTok宣稱應被過濾掉的內容。
德州檢察長Ken Paxton辦公室表示，案件接下來將進入審判階段，屆時法院將決定TikTok可能面臨的罰款及其他救濟措施。Paxton辦公室預計，審判可能安排在下個月舉行。
TikTok目前尚未立即回應路透社在正常辦公時間以外提出的置評要求。
這項裁決也讓TikTok面臨的兒少保護爭議再次受到關注。德州的訴訟核心並非單純要求社群平台限制未成年人使用，而是聚焦TikTok對自身內容管理及兒少保護功能所作出的宣傳是否與實際運作情況相符。
若最終審判認定TikTok須承擔相關責任，除了可能面臨金錢處罰，也可能被要求採取其他補救措施，進一步改變平台對未成年人內容的過濾方式及安全功能的運作。
TikTok近年也持續面臨美國各州及個人使用者針對兒少安全、平台成癮性及心理健康等議題提出的法律挑戰。公司在今年8月同意和解3起由美國年輕人提起的訴訟，原告指控社群媒體公司刻意設計容易讓使用者成癮的平台功能，並因此損害年輕人的心理健康。
Meta(META-US)同樣面臨類似法律壓力。Meta在8月同意支付最高180億美元，以和解美國境內針對社群平台成癮性的相關索賠。這顯示美國社群媒體業者正面臨日益升高的法律與監管壓力，尤其是在未成年人保護、平台設計及內容管理等領域。
此次德州裁決的關鍵在於，法院認定TikTok對內容過濾機制及Restricted Mode功能的描述，可能讓使用者形成與實際情況不符的安全認知。對TikTok而言，這不僅涉及單一州的消費者保護訴訟，也可能增加其他州政府及使用者針對平台兒少安全措施提出法律主張的空間。
隨著案件進入審判階段，TikTok後續可能面臨的罰款金額及其他救濟措施將成為市場關注焦點，而法院最終裁決也可能對社群媒體平台如何宣傳兒少安全功能，以及業者是否必須確保相關功能確實按照宣稱內容運作，產生更廣泛的影響。
paras_en: A Texas judge on Thursday ruled that TikTok violated the state’s consumer protection law by giving misleading explanations to users about how it filters content for minors and whether “Restricted Mode” can effectively block inappropriate material. The ruling raises the legal risk for TikTok in the United States regarding child safety and platform liability.

The Texas government sued TikTok in January 2025, accusing the platform of marketing itself as child‑safe and leading parents and young users to believe TikTok had taken sufficient steps to shield minors from unsuitable content.

According to the court’s decision, Texas officials pointed out that TikTok tells users that any content violating its Community Guidelines will be removed. However, the state argues that TikTok internally classifies some of that content as “hard to find” rather than “do not allow,” allowing it to remain on the platform.

Judge Cory Liu of Texas agreed with the state’s claim, finding TikTok’s practice to be a violation of the state consumer protection law. The court also concluded that Texas had proven TikTok’s “Restricted Mode” does not operate as the company publicly claims, meaning minors could still encounter content the platform says should be filtered out.

The office of Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton said the case will now move to trial, at which point the court will decide any fines and other remedies TikTok may face. Paxton’s office expects the trial could be scheduled for next month.
TikTok has not yet responded to Reuters’ request for comment outside of normal business hours.

The ruling also brings renewed focus to the controversy over TikTok’s child‑protection measures. The core of Texas’s lawsuit is not simply to restrict minors’ use of the platform, but to examine whether TikTok’s publicity about its content‑management and child‑safety features matches its actual operations.

If the trial ultimately holds TikTok liable, the company could face monetary penalties and may be ordered to implement additional remedial actions, changing how it filters content for minors and how its safety features function.

TikTok has recently faced a wave of legal challenges across U.S. states and from individual users over child safety, platform addiction, and mental‑health concerns. In August, the company agreed to settle three lawsuits brought by American youths who alleged the social‑media giant deliberately designed addictive features that harmed their mental health.

Meta (META‑US) is confronting similar legal pressure. In August, Meta agreed to pay up to $18 billion to settle U.S. claims related to the addictive nature of its social platforms. This underscores the growing legal and regulatory pressure on U.S. social‑media firms, especially regarding minors’ protection, platform design, and content moderation.

The key takeaway from the Texas decision is that the court found TikTok’s descriptions of its content‑filtering mechanisms and Restricted Mode could give users a false sense of safety. For TikTok, this not only involves a single‑state consumer‑protection suit but could also open the door for other states and users to bring claims over the platform’s child‑safety measures.

As the case moves to trial, the potential fines and other remedies TikTok may face will attract market attention, and the final ruling could have broader implications for how social‑media platforms market child‑safety features and whether they must ensure those features operate as advertised.

items.title: 黃仁勳揭AI生意經：「製造問題」就是製造需求
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Unveils AI Business Strategy: “Creating Problems” Is Creating Demand
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳看好網路安全成為人工智慧（AI）的下一個主要應用領域。他指出，AI加速程式設計自動化，不僅提高程式碼遭利用的速度，也迫使企業更快修補漏洞，正從根本改變網路攻防節奏，並為AI算力創造新的高價值需求。
黃仁勳周四出席舊金山高盛科技會議時表示，網路安全很可能成為AI的下一個主要用例。隨著AI模型大幅降低程式碼編寫門檻，可遭利用的程式碼數量增加，漏洞被發現及攻擊的速度也隨之加快，企業必須以更高效率回應並完成修復。
AI改寫網路攻防節奏
黃仁勳認為，AI對電腦程式設計的自動化，正在對網路安全產業帶來結構性衝擊。當程式碼生成速度加快，潛在安全問題與修復需求也同步擴大，網路安全因此可能成為AI下一波重要需求來源。
他直言：「有什麼比製造問題更能創造需求的方式呢？哪家公司不希望自己的市場對產品趨之若鶩、排隊搶購？」不過，他也補充，完成這件事有負責任的方式，也有不那麼值得稱道的方式。
黃仁勳此時點名網路安全，正值市場持續檢視AI投資效益之際。輝達上月公布強勁的長期銷售展望，進一步鞏固華爾街對AI資料中心支出持續擴張的信心，但市場仍要求公司證明，龐大的資本支出確實能夠創造實際經濟效益。
在此背景下，網路安全不僅是AI技術帶來的新挑戰，也可能成為推升AI基礎設施與運算需求的新出口。
強調投資標的已有真實需求
另一方面，輝達持續積極投資與併購，也引發市場關注。公司上周宣布，將以約130億美元收購AI新創公司Hugging Face，進一步擴大在AI產業鏈的布局。
針對外界質疑輝達密集投資可能形成循環性需求，黃仁勳予以否認。他表示：「這不是循環，因為我們投入一點錢，回來的是很多錢。」
他並稱，市場逐漸發現，輝達投資的企業並非不良標的，因為公司會以專業投資者的角度評估機會，不會承擔不必要的風險。
黃仁勳進一步指出，輝達決定投資前，必須先看到「十拿九穩」的機會。對他而言，最重要的判斷標準，是潛在投資標的已經擁有真實市場需求，甚至已有客戶排隊等待其產品或服務。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang is bullish that cybersecurity will become the next major application area for artificial intelligence (AI). He noted that AI‑driven acceleration of software‑development automation not only speeds up the exploitation of code but also forces companies to patch vulnerabilities faster, fundamentally changing the rhythm of cyber offense and defense and generating new high‑value demand for AI compute power.

At the Goldman Sachs technology conference in San Francisco on Thursday, Huang said cybersecurity is very likely to be AI’s next major use case. As AI models dramatically lower the barrier to writing code, the amount of exploitable code rises, and the speed at which vulnerabilities are discovered and attacked also accelerates, compelling enterprises to respond and remediate with greater efficiency.
AI Rewrites the Cybersecurity Attack‑Defense Rhythm

Huang believes that AI’s automation of computer programming is delivering a structural shock to the cybersecurity industry. When code‑generation speed increases, the pool of potential security issues and the need for fixes expand in tandem, making cybersecurity a possible major source of AI‑driven demand.

He said bluntly, “What better way to create demand than to create problems? Which company doesn’t want its market to line up for its products, queuing to buy?” He added that there are responsible ways to achieve this and ways that are less commendable.

Huang singled out cybersecurity precisely as the market continues to scrutinize AI investment returns. Nvidia released a robust long‑term sales outlook last month, further cementing Wall Street’s confidence that AI data‑center spending will keep expanding, yet investors still want the company to prove that massive cap‑ex can translate into real economic benefits.
In this backdrop, cybersecurity is not only a new challenge brought by AI technology but could also become a fresh outlet for boosting demand for AI infrastructure and computing power.
Emphasizing that investment targets must have real demand

On the other hand, Nvidia’s continued aggressive investing and acquisitions have drawn market attention. The company announced last week that it will acquire AI startup Hugging Face for about $13 billion, further expanding its footprint in the AI value chain.

Addressing external doubts that Nvidia’s intensive investing might create a circular demand, Huang denied the notion. He said, “This is not a cycle, because we put in a little money and get back a lot of money.”

He also said the market is gradually realizing that the companies Nvidia backs are not bad assets, because the firm evaluates opportunities from a professional investor’s standpoint and avoids taking unnecessary risks.

Huang added that before Nvidia decides to invest, it must first see a “ten‑out‑of‑nine” opportunity. For him, the most important judgment criterion is that the potential target already has genuine market demand, even with customers queuing for its product or service.

items.title: 日元近期強升非短線反彈？ 知名資管機構：低估修正啟動 回調即布局多頭
items.title_en: Yen's Recent Surge Not a Short-Term Bounce? Prominent Asset Management Firm: Undervaluation Correction Begins, Pullbacks Offer Bullish Positioning
paras: 日元近期強勢攀升，可能並非短期反彈，而是多年低估狀態進入更廣泛修正。歐洲資產管理公司Edmond de Rothschild多資產及對沖策略主管Michael Nizard最新表示，日元正擺脫長期由美日利差與套利交易主導的定價模式，重新回歸基本面。
Nizard說，「日元可能正在重新成為真正由基本面驅動的貨幣」，並稱未來回檔應視為重建，或是加碼日元多頭的機會。
本月以來日元已升值逾3%。日本央行(BOJ)加快緊縮的預期升溫，加上日本退休金資金配置可能改變，投資人紛紛平倉日元空單。美國財長貝森特此前更向交易員喊話「敢做空日元試試看」。
Nizard認為，近期美日聯合干預匯市同樣關鍵，市場原以為東京當局容忍日元貶值，聯合干預扭轉了預期，使日元貶值從「單向交易」變成漲跌風險並存的「雙向交易」。若日元續強，套利交易恐進一步平倉，槓桿下降將引發投資人拋售美債、信用債與股票；日本資金若回流國內，也將為全球債市帶來新波動。
他並提醒，修正過程不會是單方向，期間仍可能盤整甚至回弱，但只要趨勢不變，回檔都是布局多頭的機會。
基本面也出現改善。根據BOJ今(11)日公布的數據，8月企業商品價格指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於預期的7.4%，略低於7月修正後的7.7%，但月減0.2%。數據顯示，日企仍面臨能源、運輸、包裝與工資成本壓力，最終可能轉嫁消費者，推升通膨風險。
目前，市場普遍預估BOJ下周五(18日)將升息1碼至1.25%。
paras_en: The yen's recent strong climb may not be a short‑term rebound but rather a broader correction as it moves out of years of undervaluation. Michael Nizard, head of multi‑asset and hedge‑fund strategies at European asset manager Edmond de Rothschild, said the yen is shedding the pricing model long dominated by US‑Japan interest‑rate differentials and arbitrage trades, and is returning to fundamentals.

Nizard said, “The yen may be becoming a currency truly driven by fundamentals,” and added that any future pull‑back should be seen as a rebuilding phase, or an opportunity to add to long yen positions.

Since the start of the month the yen has appreciated by more than 3%. Expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten faster are heating up, and possible changes in Japanese pension fund allocations are prompting investors to unwind short yen positions. U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen earlier urged traders, “If you dare to short the yen, give it a try.”

Nizard sees the recent joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market as equally pivotal. The market had assumed Tokyo tolerated yen depreciation; the coordinated intervention flipped that expectation, turning yen weakness from a one‑way trade into a two‑way trade with both upside and downside risk. If the yen keeps strengthening, arbitrage positions are likely to be further unwound, reduced leverage could trigger investors to sell U.S. Treasuries, credit bonds and equities; a repatriation of Japanese capital would also introduce new volatility to global bond markets.

He cautioned that the correction will not be unidirectional; there may be periods of consolidation or even temporary weakness, but as long as the trend remains intact, each pull‑back is an opportunity to build long positions.

Fundamentals are also improving. According to data released by the BOJ today (Nov 11), the August corporate goods price index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑on‑year, above the 7.4% forecast, slightly below the revised July figure of 7.7%, and fell 0.2% month‑on‑month. The data show Japanese firms still face pressure from energy, transport, packaging and wage costs, which could eventually be passed on to consumers, raising inflation risks.
Currently the market broadly expects the BOJ to raise rates by one basis point to 1.25% on Friday, the 18th.

items.title: 日元漲勢是曇花一現？巴克萊點出兩大利多可能落空
items.title_en: Is the Yen’s Rally a Flash in the Pan? Barclays Flags Two Potential Bullish Catalysts May Miss
paras: 巴克萊表示，如果市場對日本央行加快升息，以及日本退休基金將資金轉向國內資產的預期未能實現，日元近期的急升走勢可能逆轉，兌美元恐回落至150區間高檔。
包括Shinichiro Kadota在內的策略師周四(10日)在報告中指出，日元近期走強，主要受到日本央行收緊貨幣政策的預期、退休基金資金流向的揣測，以及技術面因素推動。儘管美元兌日元跌破155附近的關鍵支撐，短期仍可能進一步走低，但長期壓抑日元的結構性因素大致未變。
日元本月迄今已上漲近4%，升至2月以來最強水準，市場看多情緒持續升溫。投資人對日本央行下周升息的預期增強，加上外界猜測日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能提高日本國內資產配置，進一步帶動日元需求。
美國財長貝森特也向交易員喊話，挑戰市場測試他推升日元的決心，並表示自己「相當清楚」日本決策官員接下來會採取什麼行動。
亞洲周四下午交易時段，日元小幅升值0.1%，報每美元兌153.45日元。
巴克萊警告，市場預期目前已處於高檔，若日元要進一步升值，日本央行可能必須釋出比預期更鷹派的訊號。市場也可能高估GPIF資金流向的潛在影響，若其資產配置最終未出現調整，日元恐面臨走勢逆轉。
此外，巴克萊指出，利差、日本股票風險溢價、外界對首相高市早苗政策的疑慮，以及結構性的日元賣盤，仍不利於日元持續升值。
paras_en: Barclays says that if market expectations of a faster rate‑hike cycle by the Bank of Japan and of Japanese pension funds shifting money into domestic assets fail to materialise, the yen’s recent sharp rise could reverse, with the dollar‑yen possibly slipping back into the high‑150s range.

Strategists, including Shinichiro Kadota, noted on Thursday (the 10th) that the yen’s recent strength has been driven mainly by expectations of tighter BOJ policy, speculation about pension fund flows and technical factors. Even though USD/JPY has broken below the key support near 155, it could still drift lower in the short term, but the structural headwinds that keep the yen subdued remain largely unchanged.

The yen is up almost 4% so far this month, reaching its strongest level since February, as bullish sentiment heats up. Investors’ expectations of a BOJ rate hike next week have risen, and speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may increase its allocation to domestic assets is further boosting yen demand.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen also called out traders, challenging the market to test her resolve to support the yen, and said she is “quite clear” about what Japanese policymakers are likely to do next.
In the Asian afternoon trading session on Thursday, the yen edged up 0.1% to 153.45 per dollar.

Barclays warns that market expectations are already at elevated levels; for the yen to rise further the BOJ may need to signal a more hawkish stance than anticipated. The market may also be over‑estimating the impact of GPIF flows, and if the fund’s asset allocation does not adjust, the yen could see its rally reverse.

Barclays also points out that interest‑rate differentials, risk premiums on Japanese equities, concerns about Prime Minister Kishida’s policies, and structural yen‑selling pressure remain headwinds to any sustained yen appreciation.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 PPI推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Rises as PPI Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周四(10日)上漲，美國年度整體生產者通膨加速，推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期。數據公布後，債券市場跌勢進一步加劇，殖利率大幅攀升，也進一步推高借貸成本。
同時，歐洲央行(ECB)如市場普遍預期升息後，歐元走弱。另一方面，市場預期日本銀行(BoJ)即將收緊貨幣政策，日元此前猛烈漲勢也暫告停歇。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報99.03。
匯市投資人周四焦點集中在美國8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)數據，8月整體PPI月增0.4%、年增5.4%，分別高於市場預期的0.4%與5.3%。此外，7月整體PPI也從原先月增0.1%、年增4.7%，上修至月增0.1%、年增4.8%。
核心PPI則月增0.2%、年增4.6%，市場原先預期分別為月增0.3%與年增4.6%。
PPI報告公布後一天，市場還將迎來受到更高度關注的消費者物價指數(CPI)數據，而就在幾天前，美國才公布表現強勁的8月非農就業報告。綜合這些指標來看，美國勞動市場依然具韌性，同時經濟也受到價格壓力困擾。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策。
這種預期也反映在聯準會利率機率上。根據CME FedWatch工具，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)9月16日升息25個基點的機率，目前已升至73%，高於PPI數據公布前的約64%。
PPI數據公布後，美股走低，美國公債殖利率同步上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期美債殖利率最新上升11.8個基點至4.955%，對利率更加敏感的2年期美債殖利率則上升12.9個基點，至4.556%。
債券市場前一個交易日同樣大幅走弱，因市場高度期待的美國財政部國債回購計畫更新，最終令投資人失望。
此外，油價漲勢周四進一步擴大，加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨價格突破每桶100美元，為5月21日以來首次。油價上漲主要受到美國與伊朗軍事衝突重新升溫推動，雙方此前曾因荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)控制權問題陷入數周僵局。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「與伊朗的戰事正在壓過華府的債券回購努力，因為不斷升高的通膨預期，對區區60億美元的回購規模而言，負擔實在太沉重。」
他表示，「白宮與財政部本身都希望利率下降，但與德黑蘭的衝突升溫，不利於油價穩定與國家預算，因為區域內的暴力攻擊正在干擾原油供應，並推高軍事支出，進而在其他條件不變下擴大財政缺口。」
「此外，這也讓聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)陷入兩難，因固定收益市場實際上正要求聯準會升息，以壓制正在加速的價格壓力。」
ECB升息 日元漲勢暫歇
歐洲央行周四如市場普遍預期，將主要政策利率上調25個基點，並指出中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來通膨壓力。
央行在聲明中警告，中東衝突持續「產生通膨壓力」，而通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的政策目標。
德意志銀行首席歐洲經濟學家Mark Wall表示，「通膨風險可能正在升高，12月進一步升息的可能性或許已經高於不升息，但歐洲央行仍需謹慎行事。過去6個月經濟表現具韌性，但天然氣價格快速上漲意味著負面的供給衝擊正在累積。這最終將傷害經濟成長，問題在於衝擊會有多大，以及何時發生。」
歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)在會後記者會上表示，由伊朗戰爭造成的「能源衝擊」可能進一步加劇，而且對其他商品價格與工資造成的第二輪影響，可能比預期更強。
《彭博》引述知情人士報導，歐洲央行官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1614美元。
日元周四暫停近期強勁的升值走勢，美元兌日元上漲0.6%，至154.34日元。不過，隨著交易員持續拆解日元利差交易空頭部位，日元仍穩守在7個月高點附近。
貨幣市場普遍預期，日銀將於9月18日升息25個基點。這項預期受到日本第2季GDP成長率上修至1.4%，以及進口通膨維持高位等因素支持。
在官方數據顯示日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元、用於支應匯市干預操作後，市場對東京匯率政策的關注依然高度升溫，其中包括近期與華府同步進行的一項歷史性干預行動。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Thursday (the 10th), as the U.S. annual overall producer price inflation accelerated, lifting expectations for another Federal Reserve rate hike. After the data were released, the bond market fell further, yields surged sharply and borrowing costs rose.

At the same time, the euro weakened after the European Central Bank, as the market broadly expected, raised rates. Conversely, the market expects the Bank of Japan to tighten policy soon, pausing the yen’s recent sharp rally.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.2% at 99.03.
FX investors on Thursday focused on the U.S. August producer price index (PPI) report.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, August overall PPI rose 0.4% month‑on‑month and 5.4% year‑on‑year, both above market expectations of 0.4% and 5.3%. In addition, July overall PPI was revised from a 0.1% monthly gain and 4.7% annual gain to a 0.1% monthly gain and 4.8% annual gain.
Core PPI rose 0.2% month‑on‑month and 4.6% year‑on‑year, versus market expectations of a 0.3% monthly rise and a 4.6% annual rise.

One day after the PPI release, the market will also receive the highly‑watched consumer price index (CPI) data, and just days earlier the U.S. posted a strong August non‑farm payroll report. Taken together, these indicators show that the U.S. labor market remains resilient while the economy is still under price pressure. In such a setting, central banks typically consider tightening monetary policy.

That expectation is reflected in Fed rate‑move probabilities. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike by the Federal Open Market Committee on September 16 have risen to 73%, up from roughly 64% before the PPI data were released.

After the PPI numbers, U.S. equities fell and Treasury yields rose as bonds were sold off. The 10‑year Treasury yield climbed 11.8 basis points to 4.955%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield jumped 12.9 basis points to 4.556%.
The bond market also weakened sharply the previous trading day, after an update to the highly anticipated U.S. Treasury repurchase program disappointed investors.

In addition, oil prices rose further on Thursday, heightening inflation concerns. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures broke the $100‑a‑barrel mark for the first time since May 21. The price gain was driven mainly by a renewed flare‑up in U.S.–Iran military tensions, after both sides spent weeks deadlocked over control of the Strait of Hormuz.

José Torres, a senior economist at Interactive Brokers, said, “The conflict with Iran is outweighing Washington’s bond‑buyback efforts, because the rising inflation expectations make even a $6 billion repurchase program a heavy burden.”

He added, “Both the White House and the Treasury want rates to fall, but the escalating clash with Tehran hurts oil‑price stability and the national budget, as regional violence disrupts crude supply and pushes up military spending, widening the fiscal gap all else equal.”
“Moreover, this puts Fed Chair Kevin Warsh in a bind, because the fixed‑income market is effectively demanding a rate hike to curb accelerating price pressures.”
ECB Rate Hike, Yen Rally Pauses

On Thursday, the European Central Bank, as broadly expected, lifted its main policy rate by 25 basis points and noted that Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price gains continue to feed inflation pressure.

In its statement, the ECB warned that the ongoing Middle‑East conflict is “creating inflationary pressure,” and that inflation is expected to stay “significantly above the 2% target for a prolonged period.”

Mark Wall, chief European economist at Deutsche Bank, said, “Inflation risks may be rising, and the odds of a further hike in December could now be higher than of holding steady, but the ECB must act prudently. The economy has shown resilience over the past six months, yet the rapid rise in gas prices signals a negative supply shock that is building up. That will ultimately hurt growth; the question is how large the shock will be and when it will hit.”

ECB President Christine Lagarde told reporters after the meeting that the “energy shock” from the Iran war could intensify further, and the second‑round effects on other commodity prices and wages may be stronger than expected.
